answer_1.quote: With the collected annotations, we propose two new tasks, pun explanation and keyword conditioned pun generation, to showcase novel tasks that our dataset uniquely enables and push the frontiers of NLU and NLG for humor.
answer_1.outputs: natural language explanations and generated puns

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we calculate word incorporation rate for both pun words and keywords, which measure the model's ability to incorporate all input keywords.

answer_4.quote: Additionally, we run human evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk, in which we asked Turkers to label whether or not a given generated pun was successful.
answer_4.guideline: Success is defined as whether the text supports both senses of the pun word.
